Build with AI: ABC (Anybody Can Code)
TechYuva × Google Developer Groups Gurugram

Got an idea? That's enough to start.

You don't need years of coding experience to build something amazing. Build with AI: ABC (Anybody Can Code) is an 8 hour, beginner-friendly Build-a-Thon organized by TechYuva in collaboration with Google Developer Groups Gurugram designed for anyone who wants to turn an idea into a working project using AI.

Whether you're writing your first line of code or you're already an experienced developer, ABC gives you the space to build, experiment, collaborate, and create with AI.

ABOUT BUILD WITH AI: ABC

  • ABC is a hands-on gateway to AI-powered development and rapid prototyping. Over the course of one action-packed day, participants will work in teams to identify an idea, design a solution, build it using AI-powered tools, and present a working prototype.
  • No prior coding experience is required. All you need is curiosity, creativity, and the willingness to build.

Think it. Build it. Ship it.

  • TOOLS YOU'LL BUILD WITH :
  • Google AI Studio — Experiment with Google's AI models and integrate intelligent, AI powered capabilities into your project.
  • Google Stitch — Turn ideas into clean and modern interfaces while accelerating your UI/UX design workflow with AI.
  • Antigravity — Accelerate development through an AI-powered coding workflow and move from concept to working product faster.

Event Details:

  • Date:  24th October
  • Venue:  Thoughtworks, Gurugram
  • Time:  10:00 AM – 6:00 PM
  • Duration:  8 Hour Build-a-Thon
  • Team Size:  2–4 Members

What You Get:

  • Prize Pool worth ₹25,000+
  • A Ticket to DevFest for winners
  • Internship opportunities for standout participants
  • Free meals throughout the event
  • Participation credits for all participants
  • Exclusive event swag
  • Recognition for everyone who successfully builds and participates

At ABC, the experience isn't only about winning. It's about taking an idea, building something real, and gaining the confidence to keep creating.

Who Can Participate?

Build with Ai: Abc Is Open to Anyone Interested in Building with Ai, Including:

  • Beginners looking to build their first project
  • Students interested in AI, technology, and development
  • Designers and creators who want to turn their ideas into working products
  • Developers looking to explore AI-powered development workflows
  • Innovators and problem-solvers who have an idea they want to bring to life
  • You don't need the perfect idea.
  • You don't need the perfect tech stack.

You just need to start.

Why Participate?

  • Many great ideas never get built because people believe they don't have enough technical experience to start. ABC is designed to change that.
  • You'll spend the day learning by doing, collaborating with fellow builders, experimenting with AI tools, solving real problems, and transforming an idea into a project you can actually demonstrate.
  • By the end of the Build-a-Thon, you'll leave with more than just a project , you'll have hands-on experience, new connections, and a better understanding of how AI can help you build faster.

Walk in with an idea. Walk out as a builder.

How to Participate:

  • Form a team of 2–4 members
  • Complete your registration on Unstop
  • Show up on 24th October with your ideas and enthusiasm
  • Build your solution during the 8-hour Build-a-Thon
  • Present your project and showcase what you've created 

IMPORTANT: JOIN THE WHATSAPP GROUP

After registering, all participants must join our official WhatsApp group to receive important event updates, coordination details, and announcements.

Join the WhatsApp Group:
https://chat.whatsapp.com/HJG7vkve7puEaQvFukUFmY

Please join the group after registration so you don't miss any important event information.

Seats are limited. Register early to secure your spot.

Anybody Can Code. Anybody Can Build.
What will you build?
